headline: Manchester United Dismisses Manager Michael Carrick Amid Poor Form
seoTitle: Manchester United Sacks Manager Michael Carrick
metaDescription: Manchester United has terminated the contract of head coach Michael Carrick following a difficult start to the Premier League season.
aiSummaryBullets: Manchester United has ended the tenure of head coach Michael Carrick following a poor start to the current Premier League season.
The club cited the necessity of change to meet its competitive ambitions as the team remains positioned in the relegation zone.
Reports indicate that current United States national team coach Mauricio Pochettino is a potential candidate to succeed Carrick.
aiContextParagraph: Manchester United has officially parted ways with head coach Michael Carrick after a ten-month period in charge. The decision follows a challenging start to the 2026 Premier League campaign, which has left the historic club struggling in the relegation zone after ten matches. The organization stated that a leadership change was required to pursue their long-term club objectives. Carrick, a 45-year-old former midfielder, was released amid ongoing discussions regarding the club's management stability in the years following the departure of long-term manager Alex Ferguson. Speculation regarding a successor has already emerged, with media outlets identifying Mauricio Pochettino, who currently manages the United States national team, as a likely candidate to take over the managerial position. This development has prompted widespread analysis of the club's recent history of high-profile coaching transitions.
